item: I was charged twice for my October subscription and need one refunded.
v1: Confirmed the duplicate October charge and issued a refund for the extra subscription payment; it will post in 3-5 business days.
v2: Thanks for reaching out about your subscription. You can view all invoices in the billing dashboard under Account Settings.

item: The export button throws a 500 error every time I click it.
v1: Reproduced the 500 on export, traced it to a timeout in the report service, deployed a fix, and verified export now completes.
v2: Exports are a popular feature. Make sure you are on the latest version and have a stable internet connection for best results.

item: I can't log in, it says my account is locked after a password reset.
v1: Unlocked the account that was flagged by the reset flow and sent a fresh reset link; confirmed the customer logged in successfully.
v2: Account security is important to us. We recommend enabling two-factor authentication to keep your account safe.

item: My invoice shows the wrong company name and I need it corrected.
v1: Updated the billing profile company name and reissued the corrected invoice PDF for the current period.
v2: Invoices are generated automatically each month. You can download them any time from the billing section.

item: The mobile app crashes on startup after the latest update.
v1: Identified a null-state crash on cold start in the latest build, shipped a hotfix, and confirmed the app launches cleanly.
v2: We release updates regularly to improve the mobile experience. Please keep auto-update enabled in your app store.

item: I was promised a 20% discount but it wasn't applied at checkout.
v1: Found the missing promo on the order, applied the 20% discount retroactively, and refunded the difference to the card on file.
v2: Discounts and promotions appear on our pricing page from time to time. Sign up for the newsletter to hear about offers.

item: API returns 401 even with a freshly generated key.
v1: Found the new key was scoped to the wrong project; regenerated it with the correct scope and confirmed authenticated calls succeed.
v2: Our API is well documented. Review the authentication guide and ensure your request includes the Authorization header.

item: Please delete my account and all associated data per my request.
v1: Verified identity, queued the account and associated data for deletion within 30 days, and sent written confirmation.
v2: We value your privacy. Our privacy policy explains how we handle and store customer data across our services.

item: You charged my old card instead of the new one I added.
v1: Set the newly added card as default, voided the charge on the old card, and reprocessed payment on the correct card.
v2: You can manage saved payment methods under Billing. Adding a card does not remove older ones automatically.

item: Search results are completely empty even for exact title matches.
v1: Found the search index had not rebuilt after migration; triggered a reindex and confirmed exact-title queries return results.
v2: Search works best with specific keywords. Try narrowing your query and using filters to improve relevance.

item: I need to transfer ownership of the workspace to a colleague.
v1: Transferred workspace ownership to the specified colleague after admin confirmation and verified their new owner permissions.
v2: Workspaces support multiple roles. Admins can be added from the team settings page whenever you need them.

item: The dashboard shows last week's numbers, not today's.
v1: Traced stale dashboard data to a broken nightly ETL job, re-ran it, and confirmed the dashboard now reflects today's numbers.
v2: Dashboards refresh periodically. You can also click refresh in the top right to pull the latest view.

item: Cancel my plan; I do not want to be billed next cycle.
v1: Cancelled the plan effective end of the current cycle and confirmed no further charges will occur; sent a cancellation receipt.
v2: We are sorry to see you go. Plans can be changed or cancelled at any time from the subscription page.
